verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say you can trigger a code review manually or automatically and control when reviews run on a pull request. Configuration can be set at org or repo level via the portal or a .pr_agent.toml file, and the CLI supports on-demand review of changes before a PR is opened. The pack gives no detail on the specific filters the story asks for, so only the on-demand and general-control parts are evidenced. Missing for 10: documented skip-draft behavior, branch-based filtering, label-based trigger/exclusion rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
